chunks: What Mūsā ibn al-Qāsim narrated from Muḥammad ibn ʿUmar ibn Yazīd, from Muḥammad ibn ʿUdhāfir, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
He must not fast the three days separately.

key_terms.الثَّلَاثَةَ: the three; referring here to three required days of fasting
key_terms.الْأَيَّامِ: days; the specified fasting days under discussion
key_terms.يَصُومُ: to fast; to observe ritual fasting

ai.seo_question: Can the three compensatory fasting days be fasted separately rather than consecutively?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the fasting of three days, stating that they are not to be observed in a separated manner. In the chapter context, it addresses the ruling on combining the Day of Tarwiyah and the Day of ʿArafah with another day after the Days of Tashrīq.
